entries.title: Ezekiel 30:1
segments: The word of Jehovah came again unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:2
segments: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Wail ye, Alas for the day!

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:3
segments: For the day is near, even the day of Jehovah is near; it shall be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:4
segments: And a sword shall come upon Egypt, and anguish shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt; and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:5
segments: Ethiopia, and Put, and Lud, and all the mingled people, and Cub, and the children of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:6
segments: Thus saith Jehovah: They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Seveneh shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:7
segments: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate; and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:8
segments: And they shall know at I am Jehovah, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:9
segments: In that day shall messengers go forth from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid; and there shall be anguish upon them, as in the day of Egypt; for, lo, it cometh.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:10
segments: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:11
segments: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought in to destroy the land; and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:12
segments: And I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men; and I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I, Jehovah, have spoken it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:13
segments: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis; and there shall be no more a prince from the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:14
segments: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments upon No.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:15
segments: And I will pour my wrath upon Sin, the stronghold of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:16
segments: And I will set a fire in Egypt: Sin shall be in great anguish, and No shall be broken up; and Memphis [shall have] adversaries in the day-time.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:17
segments: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword; and these [cities] shall go into captivity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:18
segments: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall withdraw itself, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt, and the pride of her power shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:19
segments: Thus will I execute judgments upon Egypt; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:20
segments: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first [month], in the seventh [day] of the month, that the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:21
segments: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it hath not been bound up, to apply [healing] medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it be strong to hold the sword.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:22
segments: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong [arm], and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:23
segments: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:24
segments: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:25
segments: And I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon; and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 30:26
segments: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them through the countries; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
